purpose: Cross-genre reusable video resource library: bundle original assets and third-party items only when the specific record's license/rights supports redistribution; preserve provenance, restrictions and SHA-256.

bundling_policy.allow_automatic: Original assets created by this repository; item-level CC0/verified Public Domain records; NASA-origin media only under its distinct official media-use guidance after restrictive metadata filters; every third-party item keeps its source and rights basis.
bundling_policy.deny_automatic: Non-commercial, no-derivatives, royalty-free marketplace, stock-site, unknown, conflicting, or mixed-license items unless item-level rights explicitly permit redistribution of the file itself. NASA media is not labelled CC0.
bundling_policy.review: A public-domain mark from a third-party aggregator is not automatically proof of status in every jurisdiction; CC0 is preferred for automatic bundling.

sources.title: Poly Haven — HDRIs, PBR textures and 3D models
sources.note: The official public API exposes separate asset kinds for hdris, models and textures. The build chooses compact HDRIs, complete Blender model files plus listed dependencies, and PBR channel maps. CC0 applies to the assets; live API use also requires clear source credit.

sources.title: ambientCG — PBR materials and environment assets
sources.note: CC0 assets can be commercially used and redistributed, but every downloaded asset still needs its own provenance and integrity entry.

sources.title: Openverse API — CC0 images and audio
sources.note: The builder queries the API with an explicit CC0 filter, stores source landing page / creator / license URL / hash, and rejects items with any other or missing license field. Third-party metadata can still be wrong, so the index is retained for review.

sources.title: Mixkit — free stock video, music, sound effects
sources.note: Some items are covered by Free licenses, while others have Restricted licenses. Use only items whose item-specific license fits the project. Do not mirror raw stock files into this repository's asset-release ZIP automatically.

sources.title: Pexels — stock photos and videos
sources.note: Use directly in composed videos where allowed; Pexels prohibits redistribution of content on a standalone basis. Keep it as a source link, not as a raw bundled asset pack.

sources.title: Google Fonts
sources.license: Per font — commonly SIL Open Font License; verify the selected family
sources.note: Keep the exact font license file with the font. Do not assume every family uses the same license.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
sources.kind: CC0 artwork images and object data
sources.note: The builder uses the current paginated v1.1 search endpoint and independently checks each object's isPublicDomain flag before downloading an image from images.metmuseum.org. Preserve the exact object page, title, artist and date. The Met notes third-party rights can still apply to some depicted subjects.

sources.title: Wikimedia Commons — item-verified CC0/Public Domain media
sources.license: Per item. Automatic bundling accepts only exact CC0 or Public Domain metadata.
sources.note: The builder queries file namespace 6, reads each file's extmetadata, filters out CC BY, CC BY-SA, NC, missing or ambiguous licenses, uses the item thumbnail only, and stores the source page, creator, license URL, date/title metadata and SHA-256. Public-domain content may still depict people, trademarks or other third-party rights.

sources.title: Kenney GitHub Starter Kits — CC0 Media Subset
sources.kind: 2D sprites, 3D models, textures, VFX and sound-effect media
sources.license: CC0-1.0 for media subset only; repo source code may have a separate software license
sources.note: The build reads the official README/LICENSE content from each downloaded GitHub archive and requires asset-related CC0 language before extracting approved media formats. Game scripts, executable/binary code and unrelated files are excluded. Each extracted file records the repository source, the evidence line and SHA-256. The main Kenney website packs not mirrored by these starter-kit repositories remain source-only because its downloader is browser-driven.

sources.title: NASA Image and Video Library — screened images, video and audio
sources.category: space, astronomy, Earth science, climate, aeronautics
sources.license: NASA Media Usage Guidelines; generally not copyrighted in the United States, but not CC0
sources.note: Only records attributed to NASA centers are considered. Explicit copyright/third-party-rights markers, NASA logos/seals, and obvious identifiable-person keyword categories are skipped. Every bundled record preserves source/media URL and rights basis. Credit NASA, do not imply endorsement, avoid protected insignia, and review privacy/publicity rights before commercial or promotional use.

sources.title: Library of Congress — photographs with explicit item-level rights statements
sources.category: history, maps, architecture, science, aviation, nature, industry
sources.license: Public Domain / No Known Restrictions on Publication only when explicitly stated in item record
sources.note: Only records whose own rights field explicitly states No Known Restrictions on Publication, Public Domain or No Known Copyright Restrictions are candidates. Records with missing, ambiguous or conflicting rights are skipped. Preserve the exact rights statement, item page and file URL; review context and other rights before publication.

sources.title: Smithsonian Open Access — item-level CC0 collection
sources.category: art, natural history, culture, science, objects and archival imagery
sources.license: CC0 only for items explicitly released under Smithsonian Open Access; other collection records may have different rights
sources.note: The builder queries the official Open Access API. It only bundles when both metadata_usage.access and the exact chosen media object's usage.access are CC0. Set the optional GitHub Actions secret SMITHSONIAN_API_KEY for more reliable higher-volume use; absent a secret the build tries DEMO_KEY at low volume and records API errors without claiming download success.

sources.title: Rijksmuseum Open Access — public-domain and CC0 artwork
sources.category: art, history, design, historical objects, portraits, archaeology
sources.license: CC0-1.0 or Public Domain Mark, only when the exact record marks it
sources.note: The builder harvests the official OAI-PMH EDM feed without an API key, but only downloads image records whose item metadata explicitly includes a CC0 or Public Domain Mark URL. Images are downloaded from the official IIIF host at bounded size. CC BY, ambiguous, and missing rights are skipped; item title, creator, rights statement, source and SHA-256 are retained. The museum asks for source credit where possible.

sources.title: USGS Multimedia Gallery — official science, geology, wildlife, water and hazards
sources.category: geology, volcanology, earthquakes, water, wildlife, science and environment
sources.license: U.S. public domain unless otherwise noted; each item still requires rights-marker checks
sources.note: USGS states gallery items are public domain unless otherwise noted; third-party media and identifiable personnel/publicity rights can still require review. Do not bundle an item merely because it appears on a USGS page.

sources.title: NOAA multimedia — ocean, weather, atmosphere and climate media
sources.category: ocean, climate, storms, weather, marine science and research vessels
sources.license: Generally public domain unless item credit/caption identifies restrictions; not a blanket CC0 license
sources.note: NOAA describes most agency content as public domain unless specifically noted; third-party footage, logos, identifiable people and endorsement implications need separate handling. Preserve official credit and only bundle after item-level rights checks.
